player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({role}) in a {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies game.
- Each round, submit [heads] or [tails] (or [h], [t]).
- If your choice matches your opponent’s, Player 0 wins the round; otherwise Player 1 wins.
Reply with your choice in the format '[heads]' or '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format thiam loh; [heads]' leh [tails]' te hi pe chhuak rawh.

message.round_match: Player 0 picked {choice0}; Player 1 picked {choice1}. Match -> Player 0 wins
message.round_mismatch: Player 0 chuan {choice0} a thlang; Player 1 chuan {choice1} a thlang. Mismatch -> Player 1 a chak.
